diskSizing.minimumFormula: C >= (B + 12GiB + above_guard_delta)/0.85 with B=OS/tool + seed + compressed + extraction allowance; illustrative B=39GiB gives C>=69.412GiB →70GiB filesystem. Recompute after authentic lab artifact expansion measurement; not a production guard proposal.
diskSizing.primaryDesign: Match measured filesystem capacity270430261248B on disposable258GiB virtual disk with production partition/features, not illustrative70GiB lab; guard then remains49.77867GiB. /tmp overlay + cache bind share same backing. Separate observer disk >=8GiB.
diskSizing.physicalAllocation: Use external dedicated storage, no creation on current constrained production Mac/APFS. Reserve at least full258GiB virtual disk physical backing +8GiB observer + measured snapshot/COW budget + host safety; planning floor300GiB usable with ONE active base and no snapshots. Snapshot/backup copies require additional proven unique-block budget, e.g. independent full backup adds258GiB. Sparse capacity is not free physical headroom.
diskSizing.bounds: Compressed layer <=1.5GiB each proven wrapper bound; decompressed size NOT bounded by that. The16GiB extraction allowance is planning-only. Future lab preflight must inspect authentic tar manifest/expansion and safe quotas before fill-to-band; if larger, recalc B/re-size external lab. No undersizing to force ENOSPC.

cases.name: empty cache fresh download
cases.setup: New lab cache. Full ensureScannerDatabases with missing/invalid metadata must reject SCANNER_METADATA_INVALID, NOT silently succeed. Separately label DOWNLOAD_SUBPATH: call unchanged IO assertOwner → upstream → download → read with valid pinned artifact in lab, then validate DB. Do not invent bootstrap wrapper support.
cases.expected: Full wrapper prerequisite failure; download subpath success measured separately

cases.name: existing valid naturally expired DB → newer DB
cases.setup: Use public historical DB + authentic metadata expired by NextUpdate and CLI recency window; seed both DB kinds on lab cache. Do not edit production metadata or fake freshness. Record seed checksum and new artifact digest.
cases.expected: Full current wrapper success, both DBs fresh and valid; exactly same bytes/commands/guard
components: old DB until downloader replacement phase

cases.name: existing DB + explicitly requested refresh
cases.setup: No force flag exists in frozen wrapper. Fresh DB full wrapper remains NO_ACTION and must be recorded. For forced attempt test frozen io.assertOwner → upstream → download on disposable lab only, labelled subpath. If CLI decides cache still fresh, NO_DOWNLOAD, not peak refresh success. For actual refresh use valid naturally expired seed; no trivy clean or forced flag added.
cases.trigger: existing supported download subpath; guard still required
cases.expected: Record genuine skip OR download. Count only actual download/extraction toward >=3 successful refreshes.
components: compressed layer only if CLI downloads
new extracted DB only if CLI updates

cases.name: interrupted download
cases.setup: Pin official artifact, detect compressed archive growth and no extraction writes; apply lab-only egress cut scoped to lab process or owned SIGTERM. Network retry must not turn case into a success. Preserve wrapper timeout210s/CLI3m.
cases.trigger: pause/drop at 25%,75% observed archive bytes; SIGTERM separately
cases.expected: Nonzero error, ownership cleanup observed; record temp and old DB state rather than assuming cleanup

cases.name: interrupted extraction
cases.setup: After complete compressed download, trigger owned SIGTERM on first new destination write and mid-extraction; confirm phase from filesystem events. Lab-only SIGKILL supplementary to expose deferred-cleanup loss.
cases.trigger: owned lab process only; never pkill -f broad match
cases.expected: Observe partial destination / missing old DB / leftover archive; any residue explicitly measured and isolated, no false rollback claim

cases.name: replacement/remove/copy failure
cases.setup: Same image nonroot10000. On disposable destination use narrowly scoped permission deny before remove/write, or lab-only syscall fault injection at unlink/open/write; record exact errno and phase. No global remount or production RBAC change.
cases.trigger: EACCES at actual supported destination operation. Rename-only fault NOT_APPLICABLE unless trace proves rename.
cases.expected: Nonzero and faithful cleanup observations; do not pretend atomic rename exists
components: partial destination if later write fails

cases.name: cleanup after failure
cases.setup: For every D/E/F keep the failed filesystem unchanged while measuring after exit, +1s,+10s,+60s. Check ownership pidfile, open deleted blocks, archives, cache/metadata and CLI absence. Then destroy isolated disk/snapshot only after evidence sealed.
cases.expected: CLEAN or RESIDUE or OLD_DB_LOST/PARTIAL, never equate process cleanup to DB cleanup

cases.name: guard rejection / near / above
cases.setup: Use fully allocated lab filler, no sparse-only files, same guest capacity. Initial min(nodefsAvail,imagefsAvail) at ceil(G)-1GiB, ceil(G)-4KiB, ceil(G)+4KiB and ceil(G)+8GiB. Quiesce background writes; guard checks both fresh stats <=90s.
cases.trigger: unchanged assertOwner, actual lab owned platform-heavy Lease, same stats API semantics
cases.expected: Below guard rejected before manifest/download; near guard may race and reject (record), above allows only if all other checks pass. NO below-guard bypass to force DB execution.

fastSampler.scheduler: prestarted independent sampler on observer filesystem; record actual gaps, dropped samples, execution overhead; >50ms gap invalid unless event reconstruction bounds it

directorySampler.method: stat tracked files/inodes and allocation deltas from watcher events; full recursive du at start/end and >=1s cadence to avoid workload perturbation

measurement.eventTrace: Lab-only trace ext4 block allocation/free, delayed-allocation reservations, truncate/unlink/open-close, overlay copy-up and process phase events. Observer buffers/logs outside measured filesystem; validate event accounting against statvfs and allocated-inode snapshots; track open-unlinked blocks. No eBPF privileges requested or installed this round.
measurement.peakValidity: 10ms sampling alone is a lower bound, NOT exact true peak. Reconstruct filesystem allocation high-water incl transient created/deleted files from loss-free allocation/free trace and reservation accounting. Record trace counters and lost events. If kernel instrumentation cannot account for short-lived peaks, report SAMPLED_PEAK_LOWER_BOUND / PEAK_NOT_PROVEN, no guard decision or reduction; improve isolated instrumentation under future authorization. Do not use max(bytesWritten), apparent-size or before/after as allocation peak.
measurement.formula: per device: incremental_peak=max_t(available_before - available_t), absolute_peak_used=max_t(used_t); combined concurrency only for SAME instant and shared backing. Report f_bfree and f_bavail separately, safety reserves excluded from MEASURED_PEAK. Guest physical blocks, overlay and host qcow2 peaks reported independently without double counting.
measurement.componentRules: OCI compressed_download and temporary_archive may be the same inode: count once. old_db_retained is existing_db until deletion, not an additional copy. rollback_copy=0 unless observed implementation creates it (wrapper has none). extraction temporary path only if observed dependency uses it. Sequential db/java-db peaks not summed. Retained other-kind DB stays in baseline.
measurement.failureCleanup: Observe without manual cleanup; seal artifacts; destroy disposable lab only. Cleanup insufficiency is evidence, never patch frozen tool to make experiment pass.
measurement.repeatability: >=3 real successful full B refreshes with identical seed+new digest; A/C supplemental >=3 attempts. Each failure mode >=2 where reproducible, include TERM and KILL with different cleanup guarantees. Restore clean lab snapshot between runs outside measured window; 3 repeats per free-space band. Record min/max/median/population variance, every sample and censored run. Controlled changed-digest successor run if upstream changes, separate cohort, do not merge.
measurement.labStop: Abort owned updater if physical host budget exhausted, observer drops events, unexpected target/API/production address appears, unowned process exists, or device available <8GiB (lab emergency stop only, NOT new guard). Censored peak cannot support guard reduction; re-size external lab and repeat.

isolationArchitecture: Disposable Linux arm64 VM on independent external backing; no prod kubeconfig, Secret, PVC, registry writes, PetClinic workloads, Lease or proxy. Isolated kube API with only lab harbor-trivy-0/harbor and platform-heavy/data-infra/devops stats identity, because frozen IO hardcodes these names. Exact immutable source copied read-only; record schema, imageID, binary hash, UID10000, Node version. DNS/network isolation must deny prod control plane/registry addresses before any execution. Only anonymous official GHCR read + digest-addressed mirror fetch allowed. No change to frozen hardcoded command sequence.
proxyStrategy: Prefer direct egress; independent validation-only proxy if required, no production proxy listener/runtime dependency. Production proxy was used only to GET four small public source files read-only this design round, not for a lab run; no state mutation. All future experimental routes must be isolated and logged sans credentials.
credentialsStrategy: Anonymous public token scoped repository pull only as frozen upstream uses. No production registry/age/SA secrets. Lab-only ephemeral Kube identity + Lease in isolated control plane; no prod RBAC writes. Redact Authorization/curl stdin/env, no set -x; secret references only. No credentials archived.
successCriteria: exact image/binary/frozen wrapper/Node identity pinned and effective commands match
same sources/digests/media types and applicable filesystem semantics
>=3 actual full refreshes validated with real fresh metadata and DB readable by same Trivy (isolated offline known fixture scan); no production scan
loss-free peak reconstruction OR explicitly NOT_PROVEN; no single-sample decision
representative failure cleanup outcomes captured including residual bytes and DB loss
repeatability stats and all evidence sealed; no silent discarded runs
independent backing-space/backup safety assessed separately from guest peak; no production impact

guardDecisionModel.MEASURED_PEAK: event-accounted high-water incremental allocation above authentic seed, per-device and physical host separately; no reserve hidden in peak
guardDecisionModel.SAFETY_MARGIN: separate documented DB growth horizon, artifact size variability, failure residue, measurement uncertainty, concurrent controller/container writes; each quantified by evidence, no new number this iteration
guardDecisionModel.PLATFORM_RESERVE: separate current8GiB plus capacity15% term as currently implemented; any future rationale must explain both, and avoid double-counting old cache
guardDecisionModel.GUARD_VALIDATED: repeated supported worst-case peak + documented margins fits protection, confidence/coverage sufficient
guardDecisionModel.GUARD_CONSERVATIVE_BUT_JUSTIFIED: material surplus justified by explicit growth/failure/concurrency/backing margins
guardDecisionModel.GUARD_REDUCTION_CANDIDATE: only repeated loss-free evidence and complete failures show material excess after all margins; NOT approval to change
guardDecisionModel.GUARD_INSUFFICIENT: peak/margins or safely observed failure exceed current protection; abort, no unsafe production proof
guardDecisionModel.NO_VERDICT: missing source equivalence, censored peak, skipped failures or limited sampled lower bound → no classification

changeControl: A future reduction candidate requires separate formula/number proposal, old/new risk, compatibility tests and explicit approval, versioned guard change, rollback to original sha/formula; no activation this round.
readinessReason: Current proxy live-state differs from preserved verified epoch, attribution UNKNOWN; do not assert protection=unchanged or approve runtime resume. Experimental infrastructure and telemetry still require isolated preflight; this package is design-only.
